hazards: Contains brominated flame retardants in plastic casings, lead solder on internal key matrix circuits, and batteries in wireless models.
safe_handling: Unplug wired keyboards or remove AA/AAA batteries from wireless keyboards before storage or disposal.
unsafe_actions: Do not burn plastic keycaps or throw whole keyboards into regular municipal trash bins.
what_to_do_if_damaged: Tape over cracked plastic edges and place loose keycaps or exposed internal circuit sheets inside a sealed bag.
disposal_route: Drop off at an authorized e-waste collection bin or certified electronics recycling center.
recoverable_materials: ABS/HIPS plastics, copper wiring, steel backplates, and small circuit board metals.
environmental_impact: Landfilling takes centuries to degrade and leaches brominated flame retardants and heavy metals into soil.
